messages:
Priya Shah: Quick async check-in re: HarborPay renewal — noticed embedding ingestion spikes this morning affecting batch imports. Renewal meeting Fri; need visibility and a short mitigation we can offer.
Priya Shah: What I did: pulled trace spans from the ingestion service, opened ticket CS-8274, sampled request ids, and captured a couple failing curl responses.
Priya Shah: Blocker: unsure if routing fallback to smaller embedding model triggered or if batching backlog caused KV-cache pressure. Also seeing intermittent 504s from /v1/embeddings endpoint.
Jordan Lee: looking. Can you paste the minimal failing curl + request-id? I can trace in infra logs.
Priya Shah: pasted snippet below (sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-xl-1024","input":"..."}' 
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Service Unavailable
# request-id: rp-0a1b2c3d
```

Priya Shah: Also observed increased queue depth on kafka ingestion topic `harborpay-embeddings` around 06:10 UTC.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks — we rolled a small routing tweak last night to prefer quantized variants for low-cost tenants; that could cause transient cache warming. I'll check routing logs for tenant `harborpay-prod` and the time window.
Marco Perez: From CS side I can offer a short mitigation to the customer: pause large bulk imports and retry with smaller batch sizes, or switch to async webhook mode. Which should be easiest to recommend?
Samir (Support): Pinged HarborPay PM to propose a 1hr throttling window. They asked for a technical note we can send explaining the retry/backoff guidance.
Jordan Lee: Initial look — infra shows a flurry of 502/504s near the same time and a few instances hit high GPU memory. Possible KV cache churn. @Lena can you confirm if fallback to CPU-hosted model happened? That would explain latency spike.
Lena Ortiz: Confirmed fallback events at 06:09–06:14 UTC for `embed-xl-1024` -> `embed-l-quant`. Logs show ~8% of requests hit fallback policy. Pushing a patch to limit concurrent fallbacks now.
Priya Shah: Awesome, thanks. Can we get an ETA on the patch and a temporary mitigation we can send to the customer?
Lena Ortiz: Patch rolling -> will be on canary in 10m, full rollout in 30–45m if no regressions. Mitigation: recommend retry/backoff + reduce batch size to 64 per request. I'll draft a short note.
Marco Perez: I'll draft the customer note and include suggested cURL example and backoff headers. Will also request a short extension on the renewal call to summarize.
Priya Shah: Please include the ticket CS-8274 and the dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/harborpay (for their PM). :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deployment started for routing-patch v2024.6.12-rc3 — tracking id dpl-4421 :rocket:
Jordan Lee: Monitoring infra metrics — queue depth and GPU mem usage trending down after canary. Will watch for 30m.
Priya Shah: Thanks everyone — I'll update the renewal brief with this status and flag that we requested a short throttle window. Will update thread when customer accepts.
Samir (Support): HarborPay accepted the 1hr throttle window starting 07:15 UTC. They also requested a short post-mortem after fix. :white_check_mark:
